sections.heading: KLK OLEO Life Science
paragraphs: KLK OLEO Life Science is a trusted global partner in pharmaceutical excipients and processing ingredients, committed to enhancing drug performance and sustainability.
Backed by KLK OLEO’s global oleochemical expertise and European manufacturing excellence.
Cutting edge innovation products.
Offers both standard and customised excipients with strong R&D support.
Committed to high quality, safety standards, and comprehensive regulatory documentation.
Focused on sustainability with a bio-circular, low-carbon product portfolio.

sections.heading: Solutions That Matter
paragraphs: KLK OLEO Life Science provides high-quality excipients for a wide range of applications and dosage forms.
KLK OLEO Life Science offers excipients like Glycerin, Macrogols / Polyethylene Glycols (PEGs), Polysorbates, and MCT, ensuring purity, stability, and regulatory compliance for drug formulations.
Based on extensive experience and R&D support, KLK OLEO Life Science offers tailored surfactants, which perfectly meet the requirements of dedicated applications.
With certified sites in Europe, KLK OLEO Life Science ensures consistent quality, safety, and traceability through EXCiPACT™, ISO, Halal, and Kosher standards.
KLK OLEO Life Science promotes low-carbon, bio-circular products, RSPO-certified sourcing, and reduced emissions, aligning with global environmental and ethical standards.

sections.heading: A Universal Natural Solution For Basic to Niche Applications
paragraphs: At KLK OLEO, we are committed to advancing sustainability and performance through our comprehensive portfolio of oleochemicals—natural, renewable alternatives to petrochemicals. Derived predominantly from palm oil and palm kernel oil, our oleochemical solutions support a wide array of end-use industries, from everyday consumer goods to specialised industrial applications.

Oleochemicals can replace petrochemical-based inputs in virtually all applications. With rising consumer demand for ethical and environmentally responsible products, our 100% natural-based solutions are designed to help you meet your sustainability goals while enhancing product functionality and formulation performance.

sections.heading: KLK OLEO’s Oleo Basics
paragraphs: Our Oleo Basics range features products with a high Renewable Carbon Index (RCI) of ~1.0 , underscoring our commitment to bio-based, sustainable manufacturing. The range includes:
PALMERA Fatty Acids, PALMERA Glycerine, PALMERE Methyl Esters, PALMEROL Fatty Alcohols, PALMERGY Biodiesels and PLANTERA Fatty Acids.

sections.heading: Applications of Oleochemicals
paragraphs: Animal Feeds Nutritional supplements
Biofuels Methyl esters and alcohols
Electronics Insulation and special-purpose plastic components
Food Emulsifiers, confectionery and specialty fats for bread, cakes, pastries, margarine, ice-cream and other food products
Health & Personal Care Culture media, tabletting aids, soaps, shampoos, creams, lotions
Leather Softening, dressing, polishing and treating agents
Lubricants and Hydraulic Fluids General and specialty industrial lubricants and biodegradable base oils, hydraulic fluids
Metal Work & Foundry Cutting oils, coolants, buffing and polishing compounds
Mining Surface-active agents for froth floatation of ore and oil-well drilling
Paints and Coatings Alkyd and other resins, drying oils, varnishes and other protective coatings
Plastics Stabilisers, plasticisers, mould-release agents, lubricants, anti-static agents, antifogging aids, polymerisation emulsifiers
Printing and Paper Re-cycling Printing inks, paper coatings, photographic printing, de-inking surfactants
Rubber Vulcanising agents, softeners and mould-release agents
Soaps & Detergents Industrial and domestic products, specialty surfactants
Waxes Ingredients in waxes and polishes
